'''Tynial''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who worked in the [[Pathline Tapcafe]], an establishment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]],<ref name="ROB" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> He was an agent for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], ready to give a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] to a group of Rebel agents when they used the passphrase "[[Gruuvan shaal|Gruuvan ''shaal'']]" while he was working at the Pathline Tapcafe. However, Tynial was arrested along with other non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before the Rebels arrived due to his lack of proper identification; another Rebel had to provide the datadisc instead as the Devaronian was still in Imperial detention when the group reached Brentaal.<ref name="ROB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tynial was mentioned in "[[Raid on Brentaal]]," a roleplaying adventure included in ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', a campaign book written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] and published in [[1998]] as part of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The Devaronian's name is only mentioned twice and is inconsistently spelled: as both "Tynial" and "Tynian." This article assumes that the spelling used first, "Tynial," is correct.<ref name="ROB" />
